args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (0.18) since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Rollback verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
